about: Analyser modelled as a generic product: medical-grey lower body and upper housing, clear sloped hood over the reagent carousel and bottles, sample racks with tube caps on the loading deck, front doors with grip and bottle bay, status light bar, touch-screen monitor on an arm, side vents and feet. Sits on a bench top (z = 0). Water, drainage, gases and extract reach this item via the nested shared FMC_P_MechEq_ServicePoint (Medical Equipment cannot hold pipe or duct connectors). Reference: query: analyser lab bench medical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=analyser+lab+bench+medical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
